description_en: Before the technical modules begin, this bridge lets you feel the gap this course is built for: AI can sound finished while the evidence is still missing.
description_zh: 正式进入技术模块之前，先看清这门课要补上的那层信息差：AI 说得像完成了，但证据可能还没补齐。
capability_en: You can name the course method, spot a missing piece of evidence in an AI-agent update, and say when to pause before accepting a delivery.
capability_zh: 你能说清这门课的方法，也能在一段 AI agent（AI 代理）汇报里看出缺了哪块证据，以及什么时候该先停一下再接收交付。
refusal_en: A handoff that sounds complete but has no checkable evidence.
refusal_zh: 听起来已经完成、但没有可检查证据的交付。

customization_points.default_profile: Learner has used AI to produce technical work but cannot always judge the result.
customization_points.rewrite_when: For a learner without coding-agent exposure, replace the agent transcript with a spreadsheet automation, no-code workflow, or vendor handoff while preserving the claim -> missing evidence -> pause decision.
